about_short_description.short_description: Arketa develops a business management platform with scheduling, payments, memberships, marketing, and client management tools for studios.

product.name: Arketa Booking Software
product.description: A cloud-based scheduling platform for wellness businesses to manage class and appointment bookings, including group and livestream sessions.

product.name: Arketa Marketing Automations
product.description: A toolset for wellness businesses to create and manage email and SMS marketing campaigns, automate client engagement, and track campaign performance.

product.name: Arketa AI Studio Assistant
product.description: An AI-powered virtual assistant that manages class bookings, client inquiries, and studio operations by automating repetitive tasks.

product.name: Branded Mobile App
product.description: A customizable mobile application for iOS and Android that allows wellness clients to book classes, view schedules, and stay connected with their studio.

product.name: Video Library and Digital Products
product.description: A platform feature that allows wellness businesses to offer unlimited video storage, livestream classes, courses, and digital products for client access.
